summary: No actionable defect found in the scoped change. `src/repair/loop-existing-pr.ts` now restricts existing-PR reconciliation and hold release to records whose exact repository identity is configured, and the added integration test exercises retained out-of-scope records without aborting matrix planning.

evidence: `src/repair/loop-existing-pr.ts` adds exact `configFor` scope checks before releasing existing-PR holds and before composing a per-record GitHub port, so removed targets and old installations no longer throw during matrix intake or planning.

`tests/host/matrix-actions-repository-scope_test.ts` seeds a removed target, an old-installation hold, and an unavailable target and verifies `runActionsMatrixHost` plans one sentinel cell, writes `hasCells=true`, makes no model call, and leaves the out-of-scope records unchanged.
The regression test targets the observed `matrix_plan` failure mode: retained out-of-scope records previously reached `configured` through `githubFor(record)` and raised an uncaught error.
